item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera shines a torch at different surfaces in her classroom: a glass mirror, a polished steel plate, and a rough brick wall. Which surfaces change the direction of the light and produce reflection?

options.A: the glass mirror, the polished steel plate and the rough brick wall
options.B: the glass mirror and the polished steel plate, but not the rough brick wall
options.C: the glass mirror only, but not the polished steel plate or the rough brick wall
options.D: the polished steel plate and the rough brick wall, but not the glass mirror
